# Clerk Hook and Composable Reference

_Discovery source: [Clerk's language-model documentation index](https://clerk.com/docs/llms.txt)_

Use this reference for a React hook, a Vue or Nuxt composable, an Expo native hook, or an Astro client-side store.

## Operating Guidance

- The roots named after an entry are the SDKs that document it. Confirm the target project's root is among them before importing.

## Official Sources

This reference lists every Clerk documentation page in `reference/client-side-helpers`, `reference/composables`, `reference/hooks`, `reference/native-hooks`, under headings that are folders of the page path. Pages outside the `reference` folders are in the topic references.

A framework root is the first path segment after `https://clerk.com/docs/`, such as `nextjs` or `expressjs`. An entry written as a path that starts with `<framework>` is one page that exists under each root named after it, and its URL is `https://clerk.com/docs/` followed by that path with `<framework>` replaced by one of those roots.
